From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>

Subject: Urgent: coverage gap for Jordan Lee (SWE II) — cross-team sourcing & contingency

Hi team,

Heads up — we have a coverage gap for the loop with Jordan Lee (SWE II) currently scheduled for Tue Dec 1, 2026 (PST onsite loop, remote interviewers). Two panelists had last-minute conflicts and recruiting flagged the risk this morning.

Quick context: Jordan is a final-stage candidate (coding + system design + product-fit). Hiring manager expects a decision by EOD Dec 3 if the loop completes on Dec 1. Recruiter attached resume and our debrief template.

Ask: can we source two interviewers and a debrief lead by EOD tomorrow so Tara can confirm with the candidate and finalize schedule? Options to consider:
- A) Cross-team coverage: pull one engineer from infra/web-platform and one from product/PM-aligned engineers for product-fit.
- B) Swap with on-call interviewers (short notice, acceptable if someone can swap their calendar).
- C) Use a shadow/backfill: primary interviewer + backup who can step in if something comes up.

Initial proposal: Lauren takes product-fit (if schedule aligns), Jonas covers technical (systems + design). Marissa to own debrief + score consolidation. Evelyn to be the backup/shadow. Please confirm availability and any constraints. If you can't, propose a named alternative (we need people, not generic "someone").

Attachments: Jordan_Lee_resume.pdf, debrief-template.docx, panel-scoring-sheet.xlsx

Michael
Michael Grant | Hiring Manager, Platform Services

Thanks Mike — I can take product-fit, but I have a standing all-hands at 10:30–11:15 PST on Dec 1. If we can move Jordan's product-fit slot to either 11:30 or 09:45, I can cover it fully. Otherwise I'm happy to split: do the first half (behavior + culture) and leave the technical/design part to Jonas.

If we need someone completely different for product-fit, I can reach out to Priya N. from Growth to ask for coverage (she has interview history). But I'd prefer keeping it internal to this pod for continuity.

I can also take the initial quick debrief notes right after my slot if Marissa is tied up, then hand over scoring for consolidation.

-Lauren

- 09:30–10:15 PST: Technical (systems + design) — Jonas Weber (primary); Evelyn Hart (backup)
- 10:20–11:05 PST: Product-fit + behavioral — Lauren Bishop (primary) (Lauren to shift to 10:20)
- 11:10–11:40 PST: Live coding / pair problem — Jonas to moderate (if needed) or Evelyn steps in
- 12:00–12:30 PST: Debrief + scoring consolidation — Marissa Cole (lead) + all panelists
